title: 第11章 尘埃落定清影来第12章 秘术出幽冥莲现
content_zh:
“啊.........”
“啊，滚开！！滚开！！！”
另一边，在巨力撕咬之下，何师妹也进入了碧潭幽蟒之口，身首异地。
很快，祝红菱察觉到一个巨大的蟒头凌空在自己头顶，她知道，自己时候到了，缓缓闭上了眼睛，期待着解脱。
可是，下一秒，一声巨响传来。
“彭！！！”
祝红菱微微睁开眯着的眼睛，却看到不远处半空中血雾喷溅，貌似染红一片天地一般，一青衣男子一剑劈开蟒腹，凌空而降。
正是林玄。
此时此刻，祝红菱不知为何，内心有些为林玄感到高兴，同时又极其自责的低着头，不敢与林玄对视一眼。
林玄瞥了一眼这边，手中铁剑被蟒蛇胃液腐朽许多，但在林玄手中依旧锐利非凡，寒光闪烁！
“哧哧———”
“彭！！”
他的剑域实在是太强了，剑域之内，碧潭幽蟒根本无法奈何林玄，而林玄则是如同砍瓜切菜一般，不一会就把七条碧潭幽蟒全部宰杀！
蟒尸落了一地，鲜血横流，遍地狼藉！
祝红菱看着刚刚如同天神一般的林玄，愣愣出神，见林玄收剑，朝着自己这边而来，思绪从愣神之中被拉回。
他，居然还来救助自己......
祝红菱内心纠结与羞愧难当，心里盘算着该如何面对林玄。经过被其他几个同门多次的背叛，她知道，自己刚刚的圣母之心差点害死自己。若不是林玄如天神一般从蟒腹出来，她如何还能看到这一幕。
就在祝红菱纠结忐忑之际。
却见林玄顺手捡起三个储物袋之后，只是从她旁边路过，并无一丝想要扶她或者其他她想的动作。
意识到自己自作多情，祝红菱羞愧的有点无地自容，习惯性的暗骂了一句林玄，从自己储物袋中拿出几枚丹药缓解自己的伤势。

......
修炼之人没那么容易死掉，祝红菱虽然重伤垂危，但她自己也有丹药，死不了，至于断臂，那没办法。
林玄径直走向了碧潭幽谷前方的洞穴口，路上还扔了几个储物袋，里面的好东西林玄都已经掏出来了，就一张碧水青蛇皮，其他的都是垃圾。
碧潭幽蟒的洞穴呈人高，半米宽，不是很大，但是里面却别有洞天，非常的宽敞，仿佛水帘洞宫殿一般，长满了各种花草绿植，前方更是有着一汪清泉。
“这么大的空间，居然看不见一株伴生莲花，看来碧潭幽蟒出生地还在里面。”
林玄朝着更里面的洞口走去，里面一股阴寒邪气袭来，非常冻人。
转角处正好有着一株碧潭幽蟒的伴生莲花，心中微喜，林玄加快脚步想要采摘。
但来到转角的那一瞬间，迎接林玄的是一个突然而来的血盆大口！
林玄迅速倒飞退下！
只见眼前的赫然是一条实力达到三阶的碧潭幽蟒，比之前见到的每一条都要大，身上鳞片也是暗红色的，气势逼人。
“哧哧——”
这头碧潭幽蟒貌似被惹了逆鳞一般，一下子直接激发了最强状态，想要跟林玄殊死一搏！
“不是吧，我只是想要你们一株伴生莲花罢了，用的着跟我拼命吗？”
林玄苦笑，感觉是一场硬战，这条碧潭幽蟒绝不是之前的那些土鸡瓦狗能比的，毕竟是三阶妖兽！
“哧！！”
“彭！！！”
碧潭幽蟒最强的攻击武器就是蟒尾，一尾巴扫下来，洞穴直接被毁的七七八八，威力恐怖无比。
林玄身上直接激发了剑域雏形，挡住了不少周身各种碎石乱飞。
content_en:
"Ah..."
"Ah, get away!! Get away!!!"
On the other side, under the huge bite, Junior Sister He also entered the mouth of the Bitan Serenity Python, and her head was missing.
Soon, Zhu Hongling noticed a huge python head flying above her head. She knew that her time had come, and slowly closed her eyes, looking forward to relief.
However, the next second, a loud noise came.
"Peng!!!"
Zhu Hongling opened her squinted eyes slightly, but she saw blood mist spraying in the air not far away, seemingly dyeing the whole world red. A man in green clothes slashed open the python's belly with a sword and descended from the sky.
It was Lin Xuan.
At this moment, Zhu Hongling didn't know why, but she felt a little happy for Lin Xuan in her heart. At the same time, she lowered her head extremely remorsefully and did not dare to look at Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan glanced at this side. The iron sword in his hand was much decayed by the python's gastric juice, but it was still sharp and extraordinary in Lin Xuan's hand, with a cold light shining!
"Chichi——"
"Peng!!"
His sword domain was really too strong. Within the sword domain, the Bitan Serenity Python could not do anything to Lin Xuan. Lin Xuan was just like chopping melons and vegetables, and he killed all seven Bitan Serenity Pythons in a short time!
The python corpse fell to the ground, blood flowed everywhere, and the ground was in a mess!
Zhu Hongling looked at Lin Xuan, who was like a god just now, and was in a daze. When he saw Lin Xuan sheathed his sword and came towards her, his thoughts were pulled out of his daze.
He actually came to save me...
Zhu Hongling felt entangled and ashamed, thinking about how to face Lin Xuan. After being betrayed many times by several other disciples, she knew that her Virgin Heart had almost killed her. If Lin Xuan hadn't emerged from the python's belly like a god, how could she still have seen this scene.
Just when Zhu Hongling was confused and anxious.
However, she saw that after Lin Xuan picked up the three storage bags, he just passed by her without any intention of helping her or anything else she thought of.
Realizing that she was being sentimental, Zhu Hongling felt a little ashamed. She habitually cursed Lin Xuan secretly and took out a few pills from her storage bag to relieve her injuries.
...
It is not easy for cultivators to die. Although Zhu Hongling was seriously injured and dying, she also had the elixir and could not die. As for losing her arm, there was nothing she could do.
Lin Xuan walked straight to the entrance of the cave in front of Bitan Valley. He also threw a few storage bags on the way. Lin Xuan had already taken out all the good things inside, just a piece of green snake skin, and the rest were garbage.
The cave of Bitan Youbo is human height and half a meter wide. It is not very big, but there is a cave inside. It is very spacious, like a water curtain cave palace. It is covered with various flowers, grass and green plants, and there is a clear spring in front.
"In such a large space, there is not even a single accompanying lotus. It seems that the birthplace of the Bitan Youbo is still inside."
Lin Xuan walked towards the entrance of the cave further inside. There was a cold and evil energy inside, which was very freezing.
There happened to be a lotus accompanying the Bitan Nether Boa at the corner. Lin Xuan was slightly happy, and he quickened his pace to pick it.
But the moment he turned the corner, Lin Xuan was greeted by a sudden bloody mouth!
Lin Xuan quickly flew backwards and retreated!
What he saw in front of him was a Bitan Nether Python that had reached the third level of strength. It was bigger than every other one he had seen before. The scales on its body were also dark red, and it was impressive.
"Chichi——"
This Bitan python seemed to have been provoked, and it immediately activated its strongest state, wanting to fight to the death with Lin Xuan!
"No, I just want a companion lotus from you. Do you have to fight for it with me?"
Lin Xuan smiled bitterly. It felt like a tough battle. This Bitan python was by no means comparable to the previous ones. After all, it was a third-level monster!
"Chi!!"
"Peng!!!"
The most powerful offensive weapon of the Bitan Youbo is the python's tail. Once the tail is swept down, the cave will be completely destroyed. The power is terrifying.Lin Xuan directly inspired the prototype of the sword domain, blocking a lot of debris flying around him.
